entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: I thought you lived in the actual café area.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Your room is so nice. It really suits you.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...Oh, or should I do a fortune telling?

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Y-Yeah... Being next to you[n]like this is really comforting.

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Wh-Wh-What do you mean!?[n]I-I ain't hopin' for nothin'!

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: You're always so cool... [n]and... um... confident...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: ...I'm glad I fell in love with you...

entries.speaker: Chihaya
entries.en: Can I come here again sometime...?
